description: A multi-step form: one child per step, a progress indicator, and Back, Next and Submit buttons that validate the step through the enclosing form.

props.name: titles
props.description: The title of each step, in order.

props.name: stepFields
props.description: For each step, the comma-separated form fields it holds; Next validates those fields through the enclosing `FormScope`.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: The Submit button's text, on the last step.

events.name: onNext
events.description: Fires with the step now shown, once the current step is valid.

events.name: onBack
events.description: Fires with the step now shown when the person goes back.

events.name: onSubmit
events.description: Fires when the last step is valid and the person submits.
